title: Figure 48: acoustic pressure magnitude vs radial distance, 5000 Hz in water
description: ANSYS 12.1 line graph of steady-state magnitude of pressure (Pa) as a function of radial distance (m) for 5,000 Hz with 25 elements per wavelength in water. Smooth monotonic 1/r decay curve for the uniformly radiating sphere EPW=25. BAASS underwater acoustics validation plot.
